newsitem.title: USA: US Rep. Kasich says progress made on budget talks.
newsitem.headline: US Rep. Kasich says progress made on budget talks.

text.p: House Budget Committee Chairman John Kasich Wednesday used a mountain-climbing analogy to describe budget negotiations saying he could see the peak now.
"We've kind of broken through the clouds on this climb to the top of the mountain and we can see the mountain," he told reporters.
"As to whether we're going to be able to actually get to the top of that peak has yet to be determined, but we now have it in range," Kasich said.
The Ohio Republican said he would like to see agreement reached Wednesday, but would not say what the chances were.
Kasich acknowledged it was the first time he had publicly made a statement that was as optimistic.
"For the first time, I can tell you, I can see the top of the mountain now," he said.
Any agreement would be taken back and presented to Republicans and ultimately it would be up to them whether to accept it, Kasich said.
"So I don't know whether we're going to make the ascent," he added.
